theorem lg_target {r x : ℝ} : HasDerivAt (fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))) (r * Real.exp (-(r * x))) x := by
  let f := fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))
  let df := fun a => r * Real.exp (-(r * a))
  have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x := by
    apply differentiable_at_neg
    apply differentiable_at_exp
    apply differentiable_at_const_smul
    apply differentiable_at_id
    exact x
  have h2 : (f DifferentiableAtDeriv x) = df x := by
    rw [f, df]
    simp only [neg_neg, mul_assoc, mul_one, one_mul]
    apply Deriv.neg
    apply Deriv.exp
    apply Deriv.const_smul
    apply Deriv.id
  exact HasDerivAt.ofDifferentiableAtAndDeriv h1 h2
